data.subject: Local Ledger pilot for EJF
data.body:
Hi,

EJF Capital LP’s most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in OPTU and COSO.

On August 14, OPTU received a delisting or listing-standard notice in an 8-K Item 3.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1702780/000170278026000052/optu-20260813.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records, including permits, agendas, call reports, and filings; every claim is cited.

I can send the free weekly issue or set up a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
